title: Zelensky Condemns 'Absolutely Unjust' Ally Failure to Warn Ukraine Before Russian Power Plant Strike
detail: Ukrainian President Zelensky publicly criticized allies for what he called an 'absolutely unjust' failure to provide advance warning to Ukraine before a Russian strike on a power plant. The statement underscores ongoing tensions between Kyiv and Western partners over intelligence-sharing and the timely communication of threat information that could allow Ukrainian air defenses to intercept incoming Russian attacks.
